id.field: Mahasiswa Teknik Elektro · UPN Veteran Jakarta
id.summary: Saya mendalami instalasi listrik dan sistem kendali melalui proyek, perkuliahan, kegiatan organisasi, dan pengalaman OJT di ASTON Kemayoran City Hotel.
id.cvSummary: Saya mahasiswa Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Jakarta pada program S1 Teknik Elektro. Saya memiliki pengalaman praktik kerja di Engineering Department ASTON Kemayoran City Hotel. Saya dapat merangkai instalasi penerangan dan motor listrik, menggunakan programmable logic controller (PLC), serta membaca diagram pengawatan. Saya dapat bekerja dalam tim dan menyelesaikan masalah. Saya berminat pada peluang karier di bidang teknik elektro.

en.field: Electrical Engineering student · UPN Veteran Jakarta
en.summary: I explore electrical installations and control systems through coursework, projects, student organizations, and on-the-job training at ASTON Kemayoran City Hotel.
en.cvSummary: I am an undergraduate Electrical Engineering student at Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Jakarta. I have on-the-job training experience in the Engineering Department at ASTON Kemayoran City Hotel. I can assemble lighting and electric motor installations, use programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and read wiring diagrams. I work well in a team and can solve problems. I am interested in career opportunities in electrical engineering.
